prompt:
Read this vocabulary list in clear American English at a relaxed teaching pace. Pause silently for two seconds between entries. Read each entry once, without an introduction or commentary:

walking trail.

picnic area.

joining fee.

help desk.

lost and found.

case number.

complaint.

follow up.
words: a path used for walking outdoors
a place where people can sit and eat outside
a one-time charge for becoming a member
a place or person who helps with problems
a number used to track a problem
contact again later about the same issue
